in_sanskrit.name: तेज्श्वर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who possesses Tejas, or radiance. Tejas is a property of the sun, fire, and other divine beings. It can also refer to the inner radiance or strength of an individual.

in_marathi.name: Tejshvara
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Energy and Power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tejshvara हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who has control over energy and power, a wise and powerful leader.

in_bengali.name: Tejshvara
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Energy and Power
in_bengali.long_meaning: Tejshvara একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who has control over energy and power, a wise and powerful leader.

vedic_reference.note: Tejshvara is a name of Lord Indra, the king of gods in Hindu mythology. He is the god of rain, thunderbolts, and the sky. He is also known as the god of victory and is often depicted carrying a thunderbolt or a bow and arrow.
